scope: Local packaging pilot; wheel assets are not yet published

components.purpose: Check the internal consistency of caller-declared model capabilities.
components.use_case: Before proposing a model for a fictional HVAC ticket classification request, check that its declared input, output and context limits agree.
components.establishes: Consistency of the supplied capability declaration under the documented rules.

components.purpose: Check exact proposed request-to-model assignments against declared capabilities and policy.
components.use_case: Review a fictional game's proposed dialogue request route before a separate application dispatches anything.
components.establishes: Eligibility of explicit proposed assignments under caller-supplied rules.

components.purpose: Check a bounded, explicit fallback order and its declared transition conditions.
components.use_case: Review a fictional primary and reserve model sequence before an application could use it.
components.establishes: Consistency and declared eligibility of a supplied fallback plan.

components.purpose: Compare caller-supplied attempt and result records with a recomputed fallback plan.
components.use_case: Review fictional attempt records after a separate application claims it tried a primary and reserve model.
components.establishes: Internal agreement of the supplied receipts with the declared plan.

collection.dependency_rule: Install exact-version individual wheels from the same reviewed wheel directory.

related_system.relationship: Potential manual planning and receipt-review companion to the Workbench's explicit local model workflows.
integration_requirements: Map Workbench model and request records to the versioned schemas
Test the adapter with fictional and live authorized cases
